events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting here starving and I need this sorted right now.

I'm sorry your team is waiting on lunch, let's get this sorted. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. The order ID, if you have it handy
Okay. My full name is Lucia Ferraro. The email on the account is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example, and the order number is 5105. Please hurry, everyone is still waiting.

events.text:
Thank you, Lucia. Your identity is verified, and I've reviewed order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza.

Your order is marked delivered at 6:12 PM, which was before the promised 6:15 PM time. Because you're reporting that none of the items arrived, this needs a full refund of the order total, $131.25, to your Visa ending in 4242. That amount is above what I can approve myself, so I've escalated it to a human specialist (escalation ID ESC-700). I haven't issued the refund yet.

A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I know your team needs food now, so I'd recommend also contacting Big Slice Pizza directly to try to get a replacement order sent out.
Within 24 hours? That doesn't help me at all, I have fifteen people here right now. Can't you just refund it now? It's obviously not right that it says delivered when nothing showed up.

I understand how urgent this is, and I'm sorry. I can't issue the $131.25 refund myself because it's above the amount I'm authorized to approve, so it has to go to a specialist. I've already sent them everything they need: your order, the fact that nothing arrived, and the full amount owed. You don't need to explain it again.

For food for your team right now, your best option is to call Big Slice Pizza directly. Tell them the order was marked delivered but never arrived, and ask them to send a replacement to 55 Commerce Way, Floor 3. Keep the order number O-5105 handy.

If you'd like to ask for a person, I can add that request to your case. Is there anything else I can check on your account while you reach out to the restaurant?
Okay, fine. I already pushed back once, so I'll take the specialist route. Please make sure ESC-700 gets flagged as urgent, because we're still sitting here with nothing. I'm calling Big Slice now.
